title: COVID-19 cases, deaths and vaccination during the Delta period — covid_delta
COVID-19 cases, deaths and vaccination during the Delta period — covid_delta
text: tibble 57,575 rows 9 variables: iso_code Three-letter ISO 3166-1 country code. continent Continent country. country Country name. date Date observation. population Population country. new_cases_per_million New confirmed cases per million people (7-day smoothed average). new_deaths_per_million New confirmed deaths per million people (7-day smoothed average). fully_vaccinated_pct People fully vaccinated per 100 people. stringency_index Government response stringency index (0 100, higher means stricter).

title: COVID-19 cases, deaths and vaccination during the Delta period — covid_delta
